admission.justification: Spans the settings reference and its readers: retaining every accepted key with a stated reader/enforcer or no-reader boundary is how FAM-GDXSJG keeps the reference an honest map through behavior changes.

applicability: The shipped settings reference and the onboarding path for provider, mode and feature choices.
conditions: Accepted settings keys are documented separately with their actual reader or explicit no-reader boundary; a parsed key or reference sentence is not evidence of enforcement.
orchestration.spawn.harness is read through settings.spawn_harness by role defaults and the terminal spawn resolver; concurrency limits remain accepted but unenforced.

Onboarding obtains provider, mode and feature choices through the existing public options catalog. Each view asks Paseo fresh; an unavailable part uses its last successful saved answer and is marked with its time. Without either answer, configured values are sent unchecked. A running host is not required to display saved or unknown state.
exclusions: Grouping qualityGate, concurrency, spawn and loops under one no-reader or enforcement claim.
Enforcement inferred solely from parsing or source-reference prose.
Stale inventories or unverified installed/native execution claims.
statement: The reference retains every accepted settings key and states its reader/enforcer or no-reader boundary. Onboarding obtains provider/mode/feature choices through the existing public options catalog, which asks Paseo fresh and uses its last successful answer for any part Paseo does not answer; an unanswered part with no saved answer is unknown rather than an empty offering set.
